description: A ScadRig survivor in an arena, an orbit camera behind the shoulder, and infected that walk it down. Aim, fire, reload, reset — the loop is complete, and every character is a real rig with real clips rather than a box.
highlights: ScadRig characters: pools declared at scene build, clips played per state
Orbit camera + camera-relative movement, aim on the right mouse button
Hitscan fire with tracers, an enemy pool, health, ammo and reload
